summary: 12 features and 7 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • sessions: export markdown transcripts (a935a75)
  • preset-tasks: expose execution metadata and aliases (56ff294)
  • preset-tasks: support typed fields and repository scopes (7ab3809)
  • hagitask: expose community task icons (b937622)
  • preset-catalog: add GLM and MiniMax secondary models (4ca7315)
  • preset-catalog: add command-specific system prompts (b327290)
  • auto-task: propagate project execution context (ff1edbf)

HagiCode-org/web

  • hagitask: surface public task links (91ee13d)
  • conversation: convert chat to proposal (c69591f)
  • preset-task: support declarative input bindings (31dd134)
  • hagitask: render stable task icons (943d7d8)
  • preset-task: support typed parameter values (e55e770)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • prompts: render system prompt variables (e7e124c)
  • hagitask: prefer latest plugin for duplicate preset IDs (70caa9c)

HagiCode-org/web

  • preset-task: respect declarative input bindings (423e436)
  • hagitask: preserve confirmation dialogs over drawer (974cdc2)
  • hooks: remove obsolete project path parameter (42929b6)
  • preset-task: hide overridden catalog candidates (31f76c4)
  • hagitask: use shared source dialog actions (d0f605a)
